Title: Blob storage Germany resource GUID and name changes

Body.Content:
Effective January 1, 2019, resource GUIDs and names for Azure Blob storage for Germany regions will change. If you have any billing routines that rely on names or resource GUIDs, please update them.

See the following table for the detailed breakdown.
